title: Why Trippie Redd's Mansion Is Completely Black
igCaption:
Trippie Redd bought a white Mediterranean mansion in Southwest Ranches for $7.5M in 2022, then painted the whole thing matte black, driveway included.

Would you paint your house black?

Sources: XXL, Local 10, Architecture Hub

#trippieredd #broward #miami #southflorida

scenes.text: There's a completely black mansion sitting in South Florida, and it belongs to Trippie Redd.
scenes.caption: There's a completely BLACK mansion sitting in South Florida… and it belongs to Trippie Redd.

scenes.text: It's in Southwest Ranches, a rural town in western Broward about thirty miles from Miami. Trippie bought the house in twenty twenty-two for seven and a half million dollars. It had been listed at twelve and a half million, and he got the discount because the previous owner was facing foreclosure.
scenes.caption: It's in Southwest Ranches, a rural town in western Broward about 30 miles from Miami. Trippie bought the house in 2022 for $7.5 million. It had been listed at $12.5 million, and he got the discount because the previous owner was facing foreclosure.

scenes.text: The house is almost nineteen thousand square feet on about four point six acres. Nine bedrooms, an indoor basketball court, a recording studio, a movie theater and an eight-car garage.
scenes.caption: The house is almost 19,000 sq ft on about 4.6 acres. Nine bedrooms, an indoor basketball court, a recording studio, a movie theater and an eight-car garage.
